title: anil tinctoria var. normalis
intro: Anil tinctoria var. normalis, commonly known as the normalised madder, is a plant species derived from the traditional madder plant (Rubia tinctoria). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Anil tinctoria var. normalis include pain relief, wound healing, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating various skin conditions and injuries. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
